key.name: top-bar-position
key.summary: Position of the clock in the top bar

key.name: sidebar-side
key.summary: Where the side panel opens

key.name: tray-mode
key.summary: Which top bar icons are moved inside the panel

key.name: tray-excluded
key.summary: Icons left in the top bar
key.description: Identifiers of the icons that stay in the top bar instead of moving inside the panel.

key.name: check-new-versions
key.summary: Check for new versions of Smart Calendar Hub
key.description: When the list of the settings opens, at most once a day, the latest release is read from the GitHub repository of the extension (one request, nothing about the user is sent). A newer one is shown at the bottom of the list.

key.name: version-checked-at
key.summary: Time of the last check for a new version
key.description: Seconds since 1970; used so that the check runs at most once a day.

key.name: version-latest
key.summary: Latest release found
key.description: The tag of the latest release of Smart Calendar Hub found by the last check (for example v1.2), empty before the first one.

key.name: updates-tray-icon
key.summary: Button for system updates next to the settings button
key.description: When on and no update program has a tray icon of its own, a button next to the settings button shows how many updates there are (only while there are some) and opens the System updates page. Checked when the panel opens, at most once an hour.

key.name: tray-menu-fill
key.summary: Calendar and clocks under the menus of the tray icons
key.description: When on, the calendar row, the world clocks with alarms and timers, and the bottom buttons stay visible under the menu of a tray icon (or the page of an extension), in the room it leaves free.

key.name: tray-menu-blend
key.summary: Blend the menus of the tray icons into the panel
key.description: When on, the menu of a tray icon (or the page of an extension) sits directly on the background of the panel, without a card of its own.

key.name: tray-menus-inside
key.summary: Menus of the tray icons inside the panel
key.description: The menu of a tray icon opens inside the side panel, in place of its cards, instead of floating.

key.name: tray-menus-floating
key.summary: Tray icons whose menu keeps floating
key.description: Identifiers of the tray icons whose menu opens floating even when the menus open inside the panel.

key.name: tray-items-seen
key.summary: Icons currently available (written by the extension)
key.description: "identifier TAB name" of each icon that can be moved inside the panel; used by the settings in the panel.

key.name: alert-apps
key.summary: Apps whose notifications show a red dot next to the clock

key.name: muted-apps
key.summary: Silenced apps
key.description: "identifier TAB name TAB until" (Unix seconds, 0 = always): no banner, notifications stay in the panel list, no red dot.

key.name: tray-icon-stats
key.summary: How long each tray icon has been shown (written by the extension)
key.description: "app id TAB fingerprint TAB seconds": the icon shown longest is the normal one; any other counts as an alert for the red dot.

key.name: notify-apps-seen
key.summary: Apps that sent notifications (written by the extension)
key.description: "identifier TAB name" of each app seen in the notification list; used by the settings in the panel.

key.name: calendar-side-reopen
key.summary: The calendar beside the panel when the panel opens: closed, as it was left, or open

key.name: smart-notifications
key.summary: Notification banners redrawn compact in a zone attached under the top bar at the screen edge; they wait while the pointer is in the zone (critical ones do not wait)

key.name: smart-notifications-entry
key.summary: How a smart notification comes in: from the top or from the side

key.name: smart-notifications-accent-text
key.summary: All the texts of a smart notification in GNOME's accent colour

key.name: smart-notifications-flat-icons
key.summary: The icon of a smart notification flat, in GNOME's accent colour

key.name: smart-notifications-tray
key.summary: A notification when a tray icon asks for attention

key.name: show-today-events
key.summary: Show GNOME's "Today" card with the events of the day above the notifications

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date in the side panel (when off, the sun and the moon are hidden too)

key.name: show-sun-moon
key.summary: Show the sun and the moon moving along an arc next to the date

key.name: show-moon-phase
key.summary: Draw the moon in its real phase

key.name: show-ip
key.summary: Show the IP addresses in the top bar

key.name: ip-position
key.summary: Where the IP addresses sit in the top bar

key.name: ip-show-lan
key.summary: Show the local network address

key.name: ip-show-vpn
key.summary: Show the VPN address while a VPN is active

key.name: ip-show-public
key.summary: Show the public address (asks api.ipify.org)

key.name: ip-bar-lan
key.summary: Show the local network address in the top bar (otherwise only in its menu)

key.name: ip-bar-vpn
key.summary: Show the VPN address in the top bar (otherwise only in its menu)

key.name: ip-bar-public
key.summary: Show the public address in the top bar (otherwise only in its menu)

key.name: panel-ip
key.summary: Show the IP addresses in the side panel, under the tray

key.name: panel-ip-lan
key.summary: Side panel: show the local network address

key.name: panel-ip-vpn
key.summary: Side panel: show the address of every active VPN

key.name: panel-ip-public
key.summary: Side panel: show the public address (asks api.ipify.org)

key.name: accent-top-bar
key.summary: Texts and icons of the top bar in GNOME's accent colour

key.name: accent-top-bar-tone
key.summary: Tone of the accent colour in the top bar: light tint (bright) or the full colour

key.name: battery-circle
key.summary: The battery in the top bar as a circle that empties with the charge

key.name: battery-circle-text
key.summary: The percentage inside the battery circle

key.name: top-bar-spacing
key.summary: Space on each side of the top bar icons, in pixels
key.description: 12 is the GNOME default and leaves the top bar as it is; less brings the icons closer together.

key.name: clock-weather
key.summary: Weather next to the clock: icon and temperature, temperature only, or off

key.name: clock-weather-position
key.summary: Weather after or before the clock in the top bar

key.name: clock-weather-description
key.summary: Show the weather description for a few seconds after each update

key.name: calendar-collapsed
key.summary: Collapse the calendar every time the panel opens

key.name: sidebar-width-gnome
key.summary: Panel as wide as GNOME's system menu (measured every time it opens)

key.name: sidebar-width
key.summary: Width of the side panel in pixels

key.name: sync-top-bar-organizer
key.summary: Keep the Top Bar Organizer extension in sync
key.description: When enabled, the clock position is also written into the settings of the Top Bar Organizer extension, so the two do not fight. The previous order is restored when this extension is disabled.

key.name: vesperal-hide-icon
key.summary: Hide the Vesperal icon in the top bar
key.description: With the Vesperal extension installed, its icon next to the clock is hidden; its menu still opens with a click on the sun and moon in the panel.

key.name: freon-single-icon
key.summary: One thermometer for Freon
key.description: With the Freon extension installed, its button shows a single thermometer icon instead of an icon and a temperature for each chosen sensor. Its temperatures stay in its menu.

key.name: profiles
key.summary: Profiles of the panel
key.description: Each profile has an id, a name and a colour for the settings button (color: blue, green, yellow, orange, red, purple or empty), the buttons of the bottom row (buttons: three actions), the rules of the automatic change (wifi: names of Wi-Fi networks; schedule 'on' with days 1-7, start and end as HH:MM), the order of the widgets of the panel (widgets: tray, ip, weather, date, calendar, today, notifications, clocks, and the ids of widgets of other extensions) and the widgets switched off (off). A widget of the hub the profile does not name keeps its default place after the others and is on; one of another extension is on only once switched on. The bottom row always comes last.

key.name: profile-locked
key.summary: Keep the profile in use
key.description: When enabled, the profile in use was chosen by hand and stays: the automatic changes of profile leave it alone, also after a restart.

key.name: widget-titles
key.summary: Names of the widgets of other extensions
key.description: The name each widget of another extension was added with, to show it while that extension is off or removed.

key.name: active-profile
key.summary: Profile in use
key.description: The id of the profile the panel follows; if it is not found, the first profile.

key.name: alarm-volume
key.summary: Alarm volume
key.description: In percent. While an alarm of GNOME Clocks rung by the hub rings, a muted or lower sound goes up to this volume, then back as it was.

key.name: missed-alarms
key.summary: Missed alarms
key.description: Alarms of GNOME Clocks that could not ring because GNOME Clocks had no window open: time (Unix seconds) and name. Each stays in the world clocks card until clicked.
